title: release-floor-ops-sync-and-dependency-sprintlog
content:
Release Floor Ops — weekly sync notes (03/10/2026)

Attendees: Evan Carter (chair), Priya Menon, Luis Alvarez, Maya Singh, Jordan Park, Sam Cho (SRE), Hannah Li (QA on-call)
Location: video huddle -> #release-floor (Slack)
Duration: 45m

Purpose: quick rundown of active release trains, hotfix queue, cross-team deps, and short-term mitigation for observed regressions. Focus is operational decisions and clear owners for next 72 hours.

1) High-level status
- Current release train: 2026.03-R4 (targeted GA for 2026-03-20). Core blockers reduced from 6 -> 2 since last sync.
- Hotfix queue: 3 active items (priority: P1=infra OOM on dedicated pools; P2=serving runtime mem leak on long sequences; P3=console rollout asset mismatch).
- Canary window: Open for model routing change (PR #742) — Canary traffic at 8% across us-west-2. No elevated error rates yet.

2) Blockers and mitigations
- Blocker A (INF-1289): intermittent OOMs on Dedicated GPU pools when parallel KV cache hits spike. Impact: throttled customer requests, seen across 2 Dedicated customers.
  - Mitigation implemented: temporary request rate cap on affected nodes (auto-scale annotated).
  - Owner: Luis Alvarez. ETA for root-cause patch: 2026-03-12.
  - Action: SRE to escalate node-level logs and aggregate KV hit distribution over 72h (owner: Sam Cho).

- Blocker B (REL-2025): export format change in model-compiler causing a mismatch for quantized variants in preflight tests. Breaks rollout for 2 models in R4.
  - Mitigation: pinned model-compiler to v1.9.2 for canary. A follow PR to add a compatibility shim is in review.
  - Owner: Maya Singh. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/742. Expected merge: 2026-03-11 EOD.

3) Hotfix queue (triage)
- HF-001 (P1): Dedicated pool OOMs (linked to INF-1289). Immediate plan: hotfix build with conservative allocator flags, will push to affected pools during maintenance window 2026-03-11 02:00-03:30 UTC.
  - Rollout owner: Luis. Rollback plan: revert allocator flag and re-run job. Postmortem trigger if >2 customer impact events.

- HF-002 (P2): Serving runtime mem leak during >8k token sequences. Repro on internal stress harness. Root cause traced to KV cache vertex leak when sequence >8k and batching disabled.
  - Hotfix candidate: patch to free vertex on batch rollover. Owner: Priya. Test plan: stress job + 10k token long-run for 6h. Target deploy to canary 2026-03-12.

- HF-003 (P3): Console asset mismatch for EU static CDN leading to 404s for analytics tiles. Quick revert of last console deploy planned. Owner: Jordan. Target window: 2026-03-11 05:00-05:30 UTC.

4) Canary & Rollout notes
- Canary for model routing change (PR #742) at 8% across low-latency cohort — monitoring: p99 latency, request error count, and token throughput.
- Signal thresholds: if p99 increases >15% or error count delta >40% -> immediate rollback. Alert flapping observed with the last routing change; added a 5-minute debounce rule in alerting.
- Decision: continue canary. If no regressions by 72h, proceed to staged rollout 20% -> 50% -> 100% (24h between stages). Owners: Maya (merge), Sam (SRE monitor), Hannah (QA smoke).

5) Deploy windows & blackout periods
- Next reserved deploy window for R4: 2026-03-12 02:00-06:00 UTC (lower traffic). Avoid console schema changes between 02:00-03:00 UTC due to DB maintenance.
- Hotfix windows scheduled as above; ensure all changes include rollback tag and smoke-run checklist in PR description.

6) Cross-team dependency map (shortform)
- infra/autoscaler: needs updated resource hint for multi-tenant batching (REQ: INF-1307) — owner: Luis (coord with infra team).
- compiler/team: compatibility shim for quantized exports (REL-2025) — owner: Maya.
- console: CDN invalidation automation needed to prevent asset mismatch (REQ: GTM-889) — owner: Jordan.

7) Observability & test gaps called out
- Missing coverage: long-sequence KV cache eviction path not covered in nightly regression. Action: add targeted e2e stress test (owner: Priya).
- Dashboards: Add a grouped metric pairing "kv-cache-hit/batch-size" with error-rate to surface correlation (owner: Sam).

8) Decisions made
- Defer the model-compiler major bump from R4 -> R5; apply shim and proceed with R4 GA. Rationale: reduce rollout risk; compiler bump scheduled for R5 with integration sprint.
- Approve hotfix HF-001 for immediate rollout in 03/11 window with SRE on standby.

9) Action items (explicit owners / due dates)
- Luis: deliver allocator-flag hotfix to HF-001 and run canary on affected pools (due 2026-03-11 03:30 UTC).
- Priya: land mem-leak patch, run 6h stress harness, post artefact logs to the ticket (due 2026-03-12 EOD).
- Maya: merge PR #742 compatibility shim and update release notes for R4 (due 2026-03-11 EOD).
- Jordan: revert console deploy for CDN mismatch and coordinate CDN invalidation follow-up (due 2026-03-11 06:00 UTC).
- Sam: add the kv-cache pairing metric and attach the first 24h graph to the runbook (due 2026-03-13).
- Hannah: run smoke tests after each hotfix deploy and report failures in #release-floor immediately (ongoing during windows).

10) Open questions / risks
- If allocator hotfix temporarily increases latency under high-concurrency, how do we balance cost vs reliability for committed Dedicated customers? (to review in next leadership sync).
- Are any other customers on older model-compiler versions who will be impacted by the shim? Need to inventory and notify (owner: Maya).

11) Notes for follow-up meeting (03/12/2026)
- Review HF-001 outcome and customer impact metrics.
- Validate that the canary for PR #742 remains stable at 8% and propose next step.
- Confirm infra autoscaler hints landed (INF-1307) or escalate.

Quick logs / raw snippets from meeting chat: 
- "Luis: rolling HF-001 in 10m; SRE monitoring"
- "Priya: mem-leak reproducer hitting 10k tokens — uploading logs to INF-1299"
- "Maya: will update release notes and add compat section"

Appendix (links copied here for convenience):
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/742
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinfra/internal/release-floor-runbook
- Jira: REL-2025, INF-1289, INF-1307, GTM-889

End of notes. Next sync: 2026-03-12 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC.
